statement: Model Name: Tandem
Developer: Tandem Technology, Inc. Founder & CEO is Sahir Jaggi. Clinical Intelligence led by Adam Harris, MD and Kathleen Alvarez, NP.
Developer: Tandem Technology, Inc. Founder & CEO is Sahir Jaggi. Clinical Intelligence led by Adam Harris, MD and Kathleen Alvarez, NP.
Release Stage: Commercially available.
Release Date: Company founded 2023.

Regulatory Approval Status, if applicable: No FDA clearance or approval specified or required (administrative workflow automation). Platform is described as HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified; not classified as a medical device by Tandem.
Global Availability: Available in the United States; availability abroad not clearly specified.

Summary: Tandem is an AI-powered platform that automates end-to-end medication access workflows (prior authorization submission, appeals, pharmacy routing, affordability/patient assistance enrollment, and patient communication). Integrates with provider EHRs; offered free to providers and patients (per developer materials).
Intended Use & Workflow: Automate steps of obtaining prior authorization for medications, including PA form generation/submission, appeals, pharmacy navigation, and patient communication.
Primary Intended Users: Physicians, nurse practitioners, and practice staff at outpatient practices; also used in workflows involving patients waiting to receive medications.
Necessary knowledge/expertise: No specialized technical knowledge described; requires provider e-prescribing capability.

How to Use: Typical workflow includes e-prescribing to Tandem from the EHR, optional EHR integration for record retrieval, AI-generated PA form creation, provider review/approval, submission and follow-up, appeals generation with provider review, assistance program enrollment, pharmacy routing, and patient text updates.

How to Use: Typical workflow includes e-prescribing to Tandem from the EHR, optional EHR integration for record retrieval, AI-generated PA form creation, provider review/approval, submission and follow-up, appeals generation with provider review, assistance program enrollment, pharmacy routing, and patient text updates.
Targeted patient population: U.S. patients requiring medications with prior authorization.
Patient consent or disclosure required or suggested?: Patient opt-in/consent described for participation and communications (SMS/phone outreach).

Developer-Supplied Warnings: No formal warnings specified; platform notes include: electronic prescription workflows only; optional EHR integration; manual upload required without integration; provider review/approval before submissions; administrative automation tool that does not replace clinical judgment.

Model Limitations: Described limitations include scope focused on medication PAs (not all categories), variability in performance for complex cases or non-responsive patients, not a full replacement for PA specialists, and limited public disclosure of model error rates.
Clinical Risk Level: Low-to-moderate; errors/delays could affect medication access; designed with human-in-the-loop provider review.
AI System Facts: AI-powered workflow automation platform using a human-in-the-loop approach; combines NLP and machine learning with payer/workflow automation.
